# Create Progress Bar In-World Text

Source: [4530](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4530); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Create Progress Bar In-World Text](../../api/actions/create-progress-bar-in-world-text.md).

<a id="wiki-4530-n1"></a>

- Progress in-world text persists until destroyed, uses Last Text ID, and fails at text capacity.

<a id="wiki-4530-n2"></a>

- Value is 0–100 percent; player positions place it above their head; clipping, reevaluation and non-team spectator visibility are separate choices.
